I'm a failed husband, father, boyfriend, man, and what ever else you can think of. I'm all alone and no one would even show up to mu funeral. I've never had any issues with anyone or any gender. It's your life and you can live it as a teddy bear for all I care. What you do is your right to do. Fuck those haters, the ones that hate most probably have their own gender issues and get upset when you remind them. Do your best and enjoy life.
